name: FocoProibido
version: 2 (2026-11-17, KIT RULES v9: at least 30 % brighter than v1, which is frozen in FocoProibido_v1.json)
mood: dusk, NOT night. Clearly readable. Deep purple + sunset orange, lighter purple mid-tones, indigo base lifted, purple shadows (never black), purple distance haze, soft glow, floating dust, MANY lit windows, strong warm light sources and rim lights
ratio: about 70 % purple / indigo, 20 % orange / gold, 10 % other

palette.secondaryUse: small doses: gold = windows, lamps, the tower; coral = rim light; lavender = moon, haze; cream = warm light

derived.note: value steps INSIDE the palette family for walls, asphalt, shadows, trim (the v1 values were deep #0F0D2E, wall1 #231D5C, wall2 #2B2368, wall3 #33297A, trim #4A2B8F, road #1B1748, road2 #241E5A, slab #32286F, orangeD #B2561E, goldD #B58A2E)
derived.shadowRule: shadows are this purple (or darker steps of it that stay above luminance 0.08), never black or grey

key.note: low warm key, sunset side, stronger than v1

rim.note: white characters get a strong warm orange rim from ONE side; also rim the buildings and props that face the key

fill.note: lighter purple fill from the other side

windows.note: at least 60 % of the windows lit (v1 about a quarter), gold #FFD070 and cream, a few orange; every building face toward the camera has lit windows

warmSources.note: at least 3 visible warm sources per shot (lamps, windows, fires, sun on the horizon), each with a Glow sprite and a floor light pool

fog.note: purple distance haze, lighter and thinner than v1

brightness.note: baselineLum = mean frame luminance of the v1 profile, taken from the ZUMBIS_PARTE_10 QA sheets (0.12 to 0.22, midpoint 0.17; NOT re-measured). Every shot of a new FocoProibido video must reach 1.3 x 0.17 = 0.221 or more; near-black pixels (luminance < 0.07) at most 5 % of a frame and no 1/8 x 1/8 block more than 60 % near-black. Run brightnessStat / brightnessLines (src/kit/qa.ts) on the drawn frames and LOOK at them.

characters.rule: pure white cards, never tinted by the channel; only the rim (orange one side) and the fill (purple other side) change
